game.title: Monster Hunter Wilds
game.blurb: Open-world monster-hunting action RPG from Capcom, released 2025-02-27. RAWG average playtime: 11 hours (this undercounts a full playthrough). Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Follow the story chapters across the Forbidden Lands.

chapters.summary: Side missions, investigations and quest milestones.

chapters.summary: Pop-up camps, cooking, fishing, your Seikret and Palico.

chapters.title: Gear, Ranks and Crowns
chapters.summary: High-rarity forging, Hunter Rank, zenny and crown sizes in the Hunting Log.

chapters.title: Multiplayer
chapters.summary: Hunting with others and Hunter Profiles.

notes: StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); the Walkthrough subpage does not exist yet. monsterhunter.fandom.com answers the API with about 160 linked pages, including region names (Windward Plains, Scarlet Forest, Oilwell Basin, Iceshard Cliffs, Ruins of Wyveria) and list pages for monsters, quests, weapons and armour. Those are facts we can confirm and rewrite later; no text was copied. Region names could seed chapter titles once checked in game.
